headlines.snippet: Young Israelis on vacation in Plav, Montenegro, were subjected to antisemitic and anti-Zionist calls. One individual shouted "Have you taken a break from genocide?" at them after overhearing them speak Hebrew.

headlines.snippet: The IDF is closing the medical command center established in the Gaza Division after October 7th. This closure follows a critical report by the comptroller concerning the unit formed to prevent chaos in casualty evacuation.
